name: Floating Interest Rate 22
definition: Provides the index used to define the rate and the basis point spread.

ReferenceRate.name: Reference Rate
ReferenceRate.definition: Identifies the reference index for the debt instrument.

Term.name: Term
Term.definition: Term of the reference rate of the floating rate bond. The term shall be expressed in days, weeks, months or years.

ResetFrequency.name: Reset Frequency
ResetFrequency.definition: Information related to the reset of payment frequency.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Indicates a margin, over or under an index, which determines a price or a rate for each leg of a derivative transaction with periodic payments; or a difference between two floating leg indexes.

RateAdjustment.name: Rate Adjustment
RateAdjustment.definition: Specifies the rate adjustments as determined by the rate schedule.

DayCountBasis.name: Day Count Basis
DayCountBasis.definition: Method for calculating the accrued interest on the principal amount for a fixed rate.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: Following Must be True|	/ReferenceRate Must be present| Or	/Term Must be present| Or	/PaymentFrequency Must be present| Or	/ResetFrequency Must be present| Or /Spread Must be present| Or /RateAdjustment Must be present| Or /DayCountBasis Must be present
